  16| class TicTacToe:

  18|         self.reset()
  19| 
  20|     def reset(self):
  21|         self.board = [[0 for _ in range(BOARD_WIDTH)] for _ in range(BOARD_HEIGHT)]
  22|         self.current_player = 1
  23|         self.winner = 0
  24|         self.draw = False
  25| 
  26|     def place(self, x, y):
  27|         if self.winner or self.draw or not (0 <= x < BOARD_WIDTH and 0 <= y < BOARD_HEIGHT):
  28|             return False
  29|         if self.board[y][x] != 0:
  30|             return False
  31|         self.board[y][x] = self.current_player
  32|         lines = list(self.board) + [[self.board[y][x] for y in range(3)] for x in range(3)]
  33|         lines += [[self.board[i][i] for i in range(3)], [self.board[i][2-i] for i in range(3)]]
  34|         if any(all(cell == self.current_player for cell in line) for line in lines):
  35|             self.winner = self.current_player
  36|         elif all(cell for row in self.board for cell in row):
  37|             self.draw = True
  38|         else:
  39|             self.current_player = 3 - self.current_player
  40|         return True
  41|

  45|     pygame.init()

  68|         screen.blit(font.render(status, True, (230, 235, 245)), (30, 30))

  73|                 pygame.draw.rect(screen, (42, 54, 72), rect, border_radius=12)
  74|                 player = game.board[y][x]
